## About
Earthtones Landscaping is a small artisan business run by owner and designer Chris Pappada out of Pacifica. Chris works with clients to create outdoor spaces that suit their needs, whether that's a new back yard patio with outdoor lighting and lush plantings or swapping a high maintenance front lawn for an eye catching, low-maintenance drought tolerant landscape.
Every client has different tastes, budgets, ideas and needs. Chris combines your ideas and inspiration with his own design knowledge to make something unique, and he stays on site working on and crafting each project himself.
Earthtones has a 5 star Google rating from 25 reviews.

## Services
- Design Services: Chris meets with you, looks at your space and works your ideas into a design. Smaller jobs can get plant lists, style photos and material samples instead of scaled blueprints.
- Installation Services: Clearing out old plants, lawn and debris, then building the hardscape, gopher wire, lighting and irrigation, and finishing with plants, ground covers and bark or gravel.
- Patios & pathways: Natural and square cut flagstone or slate, pavers, stamped concrete, decomposed granite, gravel and wood platform decks.
- Retaining walls: Wood, concrete, ledge stone and ledge stone veneer, concrete blocks and natural stone walls.
- Plants: Drought tolerant shrubs, trees, perennials, grasses, ground covers, cactus, palm trees and succulents, with soil amendments for every planting area.
- Drip irrigation systems: Automated controllers, valves, drip lines, emitters, tech-line and sprinklers.
- Drainage: French drains and standard landscape drainage.
- Lighting: Low voltage outdoor LED lighting systems for patios, paths and plantings.

## FAQ
Q: Is the first consultation free?
A: Yes. Chris offers one free initial consultation to look at your space and talk through your ideas, then provides a free project cost estimate based on that meeting.

Q: Do you charge for design work?
A: After the initial consultation, design plans and time spent developing designs are billed. For smaller jobs, plant lists, style photos and material samples are included in the installation cost once a contract is signed. CAD or hand drawn blueprints and digital design images are billed separately.

Q: Do you offer weekly maintenance?
A: No weekly maintenance or lawn care, but Chris does offer occasional seasonal maintenance and check ups on landscapes he installs.

Q: Who will actually be working on my yard?
A: Chris himself. Earthtones is a small artisan business, and the owner is on site working on every project.
